material.description: NIST, “SI Units,” section “Base and Derived Units,” distinguishes the seven base units from derived units and identifies 22 derived units with special names and symbols. This supports the Claim only in that defined category: 22 is not the total number of all possible SI derived units. Source attribution: NIST, SI Units (https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/metric-si/si-units). This is a factual paraphrase; no graphics or third-party assets are reproduced.
